_: The watch list for guard.py. ⭐ THIS IS DATA. Widening the guard is an edit to this list, not to code. Paths are globs relative to walkthrough/. Every entry MUST carry a `why` — it is printed verbatim when the file goes STALE, and it is the difference between 'something changed' (which gets ignored) and 'go re-read Part 3 against the failure-mode list' (which gets done).
_rule: Watch a file if it is a TRANSCRIPTION of the design — if the design moving can make it wrong without anyone editing it. Do not watch a file merely because it is important; a guard that fires on everything fires on nothing.

watch.why: The design itself, and the source of truth for this whole directory. If it moved, every transcription of it below is suspect until re-checked.

The stage-1 prompt is a TRANSCRIPTION of the design's rules, failure modes and worked examples. Nothing links the two: the design can move and the prompt keeps confidently instructing the old rules. Re-check the failure-mode list and the worked example against the design's problem table.

The output contract encodes the design's rulings — required fields, licence values, what counts as a valid citation. A ruling changed in the design and not here produces output that validates and is wrong. Re-check the required fields against the design's stage-2 checks and invariants.
